meta.name: Lane taxonomy
meta.structure: family > lane > role. Seniority is the role's level plus the lane's ladder template. Work mode is per role.

payoffs.linear: Pay rises steadily with experience; narrow spread between people.
payoffs.linear_high_floor: Secure, well-paid floor from the start (licensed or scarce skills); moderate ceiling.
payoffs.convex: Base plus variable pay (commission, bonus); top performers earn several times the median.
payoffs.steep: Up-or-out or equity-heavy; a minority reaches very high pay (partner, founder, PE carry).
payoffs.winner_take_all: A small top group captures most of the income; the median earns little or nothing.

entry.open: No formal requirement; you can start by doing the work.
entry.course: Short course or certificate (weeks to months).
entry.apprenticeship: Vocational education and apprenticeship (in Norway: fagbrev).
entry.advanced: Master's, professional or doctoral degree required.
entry.selection: Talent-based or competitive selection (tryouts, auditions, admission tests).

sprint.direct: You can do the real work in a 1-3 week sprint (e.g. make sales calls, publish videos).
sprint.simulated: A sprint can use realistic practice tasks (e.g. build an app, model a company, design a brand).
sprint.shadow: Only observation, interviews and small related tasks are possible (licensed or safety-critical work).

tags.hunting: Finding new customers or opportunities; frequent rejection

tags.persuasion: Changing minds; selling ideas or products
tags.negotiation: Bargaining over price, terms or outcomes
tags.analytical: Reasoning through complex problems and data
tags.numbers: Working with figures, money and quantitative models
tags.aesthetic: Visual or sensory taste and judgement
tags.outdoor: Much of the work is outdoors or in the field
tags.care: Helping, treating or looking after people
tags.leadership: Leading people and taking responsibility for their output
tags.visible: Working in front of an audience or the public eye
tags.team: Mostly working in a close team
tags.variable_pay: A large share of pay depends on results
tags.risk: Income or outcomes are uncertain; real downside
tags.travel: Frequent travel or time away from home
tags.practice: Mastery requires years of deliberate practice
tags.autonomy: You set your own schedule and direction
